archetypes.name: dyn-lint-routing
archetypes.rationale: Fast-fail routing depends on precise log classification and dispatch ordering.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the lint-fix fast-fail classifier and its placement in run_lint_fix. Focus on whether structural Ruff diagnostics and complexity-baseline rows route to main-agent-required before external dispatch while no-tools and normal fixable failures keep their existing outcomes. Check regex specificity for false positives and bounded-log behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
